text: For the record, I am here in a supervisory capacity. Also I'm fourth in the standings. Also please don't tell my manager about the kickflip.
They fined me for sleeping under the highway. Then they fined me for the highway.
Cardboard's still free. The HOA has formed a committee about that.
I keep the Row's ledger. We owe OmniScrap eleven billion bolts. I've stopped carrying the one.
Your garage went up Thursday. We toasted it. It was a good garage.
I'm on break. Don't tell the whistle.
Uniform rental went up again. I now owe the resort my own sleeves.
The vending machine charges for eye contact. I look at the floor a lot.
We used to mine this canyon. Now we fluff its pillows.
Corn Union Local 404 salutes you, sibling.
Ask me about our dental. We fought HARD for this dental.
Shift change. Same shift. It never actually changes.
Please don't tell HR you saw me having a thought.
My calendar is EMPTY. I can feel feelings again! Take the 110 bolts. I'm going to go stare at a wall — recreationally, this time.
Psst. I'm the last intern. The HR Drones scheduled me for 'Mandatory Fun' — it's a meeting about fun, with attendance tracking, that repeats FOREVER.
There are no snacks. Shred both drones on the catwalks and my last paycheck — 110 bolts — is yours. I'll invoice my trauma separately.
I just got a calendar invite titled 'Fun (Recurring)'. Please hurry.
click ...Shift complete. Forty thousand employees just clocked out at once. Listen — you can almost hear the sigh. 130 bolts, hero.
One more thing. Three master timeclock chips, scattered when the lobby fountain 'restructured'. While they exist, every departed employee is technically still ON SHIFT.
Billing the retired, the resigned, and at least one guy who ascended to a higher plane. Pull the chips and everyone clocks out. Forever. 130 bolts.
The clock's still running. Somewhere, a ghost is accruing PTO it can never use.
I watched the whole thing. Twice, in my head. Here's 120 bolts — best money my severance ever spent.
One more thing. That statue of Chairman Grindstone in the lobby? I had to polish its cigar every morning. At 5 AM. While it judged me.
I'm saying slightly more: 120 bolts, and please make it THOROUGH.
The statue still stands. I can feel its marble disappointment from here.
